title: Multivariate polynomial division over a ring with unit leading coefficients
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $s,t\ge0$, and put $P=R[X_1,\ldots,X_s]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Let $\prec$ be a total well-order on $\mathbf N^s$ with $0$ least, preserved by addition. For a nonzero polynomial $h$, let $\operatorname{LM}(h)$ be the largest exponent in its finite support and $\operatorname{LC}(h)$ its coefficient there. Suppose $h_1,\ldots,h_t\in P$ are nonzero and each $\operatorname{LC}(h_i)$ is a unit of $R$ (has a multiplicative inverse in $R$). For every $p\in P$ there are $a_1,\ldots,a_t,z\in P$ such that
$$p=\sum_{i=1}^t a_i h_i+z,$$
and every exponent $
u$ with nonzero coefficient in $z$ satisfies $\operatorname{LM}(h_i)
leq
u$ componentwise for every $i$. No field, domain or Gröbner-basis hypothesis is assumed. The empty list and $s=0$ are included.
